title: KPI / Performance Monitoring Technology
metaDescription: Automated KPI capture technology tracking leading and lagging indicators, feeding the Track, Trend, Measure, Improve model toward Best-in-Class performance.
heroDek: A negative trend that only shows up in the annual report already cost you a year. GSS builds the technology that surfaces it while there's still time to act.
contextHeading: A performance model is only as good as its data pipeline
contextParagraphs: Track, Trend, Measure, Improve works as a management model regardless of how the data gets collected. In practice, though, most of it breaks down at collection. Indicators pulled together manually from logs, incident reports, and spreadsheets arrive late, arrive inconsistently, and arrive too aggregated to show a negative trend before it's already an event.

GSS builds the technology layer underneath that model. Automated KPI capture draws directly from the systems already generating the data, such as access control, alarm management, training records, and incident logs, rather than a manual reporting cycle bolted on after the fact. Leading and lagging indicators are captured separately, on a cadence tight enough that decline is visible while it's still a trend and not yet a finding.

The output is built to be read, not just stored, with dashboards structured around defined Best-in-Class benchmarks, so a metric's meaning is immediately clear against baseline and target rather than requiring a separate analysis step every reporting cycle.

methodology.label: Indicator Definition
methodology.body: Leading and lagging KPIs defined from benchmarking and subject-matter expertise.

methodology.label: Source System Mapping
methodology.body: Data sources identified across access control, alarms, training, and incident systems.

methodology.label: Automated Capture Design
methodology.body: Collection pipelines built to pull data directly rather than through manual reporting.

methodology.label: Trend & Threshold Logic
methodology.body: Decline thresholds set so a negative trend surfaces before it becomes an event.

methodology.label: Dashboard Design
methodology.body: Metrics presented against defined Best-in-Class benchmarks, not raw numbers alone.

methodology.label: Roadmap Integration
methodology.body: Dashboard output tied to the improvement roadmap and milestone tracking.

faq.q: Does this replace our existing reporting process or sit alongside it?
faq.a: It's designed to replace the manual collection step specifically, pulling data automatically from source systems rather than through spreadsheets, while feeding the same reporting structure the organization already uses.

Benchmarks are set from industry-standard frameworks and subject-matter expertise, then calibrated to the organization's own baseline so the dashboard reflects a realistic improvement path rather than an arbitrary target.

faq.q: Can this integrate with systems that predate the KPI program?
faq.a: Yes. Data source mapping is done against whatever systems are actually in place, and capture is built to pull from legacy systems as readily as newer ones.
